name: offertrail
description: Offertrail — OpenAPI-first DDD monorepo (journey offer studio)

scripts.build: pnpm --filter @offertrail/core build && pnpm --filter @offertrail/services build && pnpm --filter @offertrail/adapters build && pnpm --filter @offertrail/api-server build
scripts.codegen:core: node scripts/sync-codegen-paths.mjs && PYTHONPATH=.codegen/codegen/src python3 -m zero_codegen.cli.main generate --all --layers core --config .codegen/.zero-codegen-merged.json --skip-build
scripts.codegen:identity: node scripts/sync-codegen-paths.mjs && PYTHONPATH=.codegen/codegen/src python3 -m zero_codegen.cli.main generate --domain identity --config .codegen/.zero-codegen-merged.json --skip-build
scripts.codegen:journeys: node scripts/sync-codegen-paths.mjs && PYTHONPATH=.codegen/codegen/src python3 -m zero_codegen.cli.main generate --domain journeys --config .codegen/.zero-codegen-merged.json --skip-build
scripts.codegen:offers: node scripts/sync-codegen-paths.mjs && PYTHONPATH=.codegen/codegen/src python3 -m zero_codegen.cli.main generate --domain offers --config .codegen/.zero-codegen-merged.json --skip-build
scripts.codegen:consents: node scripts/sync-codegen-paths.mjs && PYTHONPATH=.codegen/codegen/src python3 -m zero_codegen.cli.main generate --domain consents --config .codegen/.zero-codegen-merged.json --skip-build
scripts.codegen:fulfilments: node scripts/sync-codegen-paths.mjs && PYTHONPATH=.codegen/codegen/src python3 -m zero_codegen.cli.main generate --domain fulfilments --config .codegen/.zero-codegen-merged.json --skip-build
scripts.codegen:incidents: node scripts/sync-codegen-paths.mjs && PYTHONPATH=.codegen/codegen/src python3 -m zero_codegen.cli.main generate --domain incidents --config .codegen/.zero-codegen-merged.json --skip-build
scripts.codegen:reporting: node scripts/sync-codegen-paths.mjs && PYTHONPATH=.codegen/codegen/src python3 -m zero_codegen.cli.main generate --domain reporting --config .codegen/.zero-codegen-merged.json --skip-build
scripts.codegen:all: node scripts/sync-codegen-paths.mjs && PYTHONPATH=.codegen/codegen/src python3 -m zero_codegen.cli.main generate --all --config .codegen/.zero-codegen-merged.json --skip-build
